cells.scene: A simple handmade craft has become a branded-looking mass-produced product shown in many identical boxes on a shop shelf, no actual brands.
Several sacks of grain and crates of plain produce arranged for sale in a market warehouse, tradable goods.
An adult explains an honest excuse for arriving late to a manager, palms open and concerned apologetic face, simple clock and delayed train ticket nearby.
An adult stares at an unfamiliar machine's controls with a puzzled expression and no idea which button to press.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — commercialization (n.商品化): A simple handmade craft has become a branded-looking mass-produced product shown in many identical boxes on a shop shelf, no actual brands.
TOP RIGHT — commodity (n.商品): Several sacks of grain and crates of plain produce arranged for sale in a market warehouse, tradable goods.
BOTTOM LEFT — plead (v.找(借口)，辩解): An adult explains an honest excuse for arriving late to a manager, palms open and concerned apologetic face, simple clock and delayed train ticket nearby.
BOTTOM RIGHT — ignorance (n.无知，不懂): An adult stares at an unfamiliar machine's controls with a puzzled expression and no idea which button to press.
review_notes: All four cells visually checked: handmade cup has become multiple identical retail packages; sacks and produce are commodities; late worker explains train delay; unsure user confronts unfamiliar controls. Anatomy, object silhouettes and cell separation are clear.
